name: bu_Al8O12
title: Al2O3 (Al8O12) crystal
description: Crystal structure prediction of Al2O3 with 4 formula units (20 atoms) per cell. The experimental ground state corundum (alpha-Al2O3, R-3c; this cell is twice its rhombohedral primitive cell) is also the NEP89 global minimum; theta-Al2O3 (beta-Ga2O3 type, mixed tetrahedral/octahedral Al, +36 meV/atom with NEP89) is a deep competing funnel.
